description: The supplied file is the main source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe front-end application. It defines the app's theme, main widget, game screen widget, and various UI components like counters, turn indicator, and game board, including game logic for handling moves and determining winners.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up the application theme and home screen.

classes.name: TicTacToeScreen
classes.description: Main stateful widget that manages the game state, counters, and UI layout.

classes.name: _TicTacToeScreenState
classes.description: State class for TicTacToeScreen, handling game logic, UI updates, and user interactions.

classes.name: _CounterChip
classes.description: Stateless widget displaying the win counts for a player.

classes.name: _TurnPill
classes.description: Stateless widget indicating which player's turn it is.

classes.name: _Board
classes.description: Widget rendering the 3x3 game grid with interactive tiles.

classes.name: _BoardTile
classes.description: Widget representing a single tic tac toe cell with visual feedback and tap handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, runs the MyApp widget.

methods.name: MyApp
methods.description: Constructor for the root widget, sets up theme.

methods.name: _oceanColorScheme
methods.description: Defines a custom color scheme for the app, with Ocean Professional palette.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Creates ThemeData using the custom color scheme for consistent styling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp, returning MaterialApp with theme and home widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for TicTacToeScreen.

methods.name: _onCellTap
methods.description: Handles a tap on a board cell, updates game state and checks for game end.

methods.name: _checkGameEnd
methods.description: Determines if there's a win or draw after each move, updates counters and states.

methods.name: _showGameEndMessage
methods.description: Displays a message via SnackBar when game ends with a win or draw.

methods.name: _restartRound
methods.description: Resets the game board for a new round while preserving win counters.
